input: Apply for a professional certification in project management

gold.taskTitle: Apply for a Project Management Certification
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to apply for a professional certification in project management and needs a clear, actionable plan to do so.

questions.title: Which specific certification are you targeting, e.g. PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2?
questions.description: Identify the exact certification the user wants to pursue.

questions.title: What is your current level of project management experience?
questions.description: Understand the user's professional background to assess eligibility and readiness.

questions.title: Have you already reviewed the official eligibility requirements for this certification?
questions.description: Determine whether the user knows what education, experience hours, or training are required.

questions.title: What is your target date for submitting the application?
questions.description: Establish a deadline to structure the preparation timeline.

questions.title: Do you need to complete a training course before applying?
questions.description: Find out if formal training or contact hours are still required before the application can be filed.

questions.title: What is your preferred study or preparation format, self-paced or instructor-led?
questions.description: Understand how the user learns best to recommend appropriate preparation resources.

questions.title: What is your budget for exam fees, study materials, and training?
questions.description: Clarify financial constraints so the plan stays realistic and achievable.
